<quote by="Proposed: Kallavesa, Seconded: Kahraman">To commission the Hall of Rund in Rundhal, Kallavesa, a sinecure giving liao. To be held by the Speaker of the Crows who will lead and guide the National Assembly, appointed by the Wintermark National Assembly.</quote>
==Overview==
* Constructs a [[sinecure]] in [[Kallavesa]] as per the '''[[Old_ways#The_Hall_of_Rund|Old ways]]''' wind of fortune
* Passed
==Date==
* Winter 385YE
==Cost==
* Costs as per opportunity
* 10 wains of weirwood
* 6 wains of white granite
* 48 crowns
* Three months to complete
==Progress==
{{CommissionProgress|Hall_of_Rund}}
==Outcome==
* Now that work is complete, the [[Speaker of the Crows]] will be able to be appointed by the National Assembly of Wintermark for the first time at the Spring Equinox 386YE
